pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.root_cause_summary: P17-H2 (95% autonomous zero-world_id retrieval), P17-H4 (10/10 outdated memory detection, 0.0040 Stage 5 adaptation, 0.0019 W17_alpha retention), and P17-H5 (264 params, 0 raw replay) all passed on the locked Stage B run, with EXACT 0.0000 forgetting on W17_alpha and W17_beta. Both P17-H1 and P17-H3 missed solely because Stage 3 (W17_gamma_shared, N=10 shots yielding G~7 unique corners) ran 10-DOF (R + b_adapter) alignment on only ~7 unique points, overfitting both W17_alpha and W17_beta cores to spurious low training loss (mean gamma=0.1764).
pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.first_principles_solution: Added Occam-Hierarchy Alignment to ModularTransferModelV3.adapt_few_shot: attempts 6-DOF pure O(K) alignment first (30 restarts when G <= 10) and unlocks the 4 extra b_adapter offset DOF only when 6-DOF fails the replicate noise-floor test (preserving exact offset invariance while eliminating 10-DOF overfitting in ultra-few-shot regimes).
